spec: Add sanitizeCandidateEnv(baseEnv = process.env) in packages/gate-fuzzing/lib/sandbox.mjs that returns a scrubbed copy of baseEnv omitting ADLC_* control variables and secret-bearing variable names (*_API_KEY, *_KEY, *_SECRET, *SECRET, *_TOKEN, *TOKEN, *PASSWORD*, AWS_*, GOOGLE_*, GCP_*, AZURE_*, GH_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, *CREDENTIAL*, NPM_TOKEN). Default both spawnSandboxed and spawnCandidateCmd (--unsafe-no-sandbox branch) to sanitizeCandidateEnv() when no explicit env option is passed. Add unit tests in packages/gate-fuzzing/test/sandbox.test.mjs.
title: gate-fuzzing: scrub ADLC_* and secret env vars before spawning candidate setup/witness commands (#648)
